items.source: paths - the paths to be converted
items.translation: paths - 待转换的路径

items.source: resourceLoader - the ResourceLoader to use to convert the paths
items.translation: resourceLoader - 用于转换路径的 ResourceLoader。

items.source: Convert the supplied paths to a list of Resource handles using the given ResourceLoader and Environment.
items.translation: 将提供的路径转换为使用给定的ResourceLoader和Environment的Resource处理器列表。

items.source: Convert the supplied paths to a list of Resource handles using the given ResourceLoader.
items.translation: 将提供的路径转换为使用给定的ResourceLoader的Resource处理器列表。

items.source: Convert the supplied paths to an array of Resource handles using the given ResourceLoader.
items.translation: 将提供的路径转换为使用给定的ResourceLoader的Resource处理器数组。

items.source: clazz - the class with which the paths are associated
items.translation: clazz - 与路径关联的类

items.source: a new array of converted resource paths
items.translation: 一个已转换资源路径的新数组

items.source: a new, mutable list of resources
items.translation: 一个新的可变资源列表

items.source: Delegates to convertToClasspathResourcePaths(Class, boolean, String...) with false supplied for the preservePlaceholders flag.
items.translation: 委托给convertToClasspathResourcePaths(Class, boolean, String...)，并为`preservePlaceholders` 标志提供 `false`。

items.source: Each path will then be cleaned, unless the preservePlaceholders flag is true and the path contains one or more placeholders in the form ${placeholder.name}.
items.translation: 每个路径随后将被清理，除非preservePlaceholders标志为true且路径包含一个或多个形式为${placeholder.name}的占位符。

items.source: For each of the supplied paths:
items.translation: 对于提供的每个路径：

items.source: Utility methods for working with resources within the Spring TestContext Framework. Mainly for internal use within the framework.
items.translation: 用于在Spring TestContext Framework中处理资源的实用方法。主要用于框架内部使用。

items.source: Convert the supplied paths to classpath resource paths.
items.translation: 将提供的路径转换为类路径资源路径。

items.source: A path which is already prefixed with a URL protocol (for example, classpath:, file:, http:, etc.) will not have its protocol modified.
items.translation: 已使用 URL 协议（例如，`classpath:`、`file:`、`http:` 等）进行前缀的路径，其协议不会被修改。

items.source: A plain path — for example, "context.xml" — will be treated as a classpath resource that is relative to the package in which the specified class is defined. Such a path will be prepended with the classpath: prefix and the path to the package for the class.
items.translation: 一个普通路径——例如 `"context.xml"` ——将被视为相对于指定类所在包中的类路径资源。此类路径将添加 `classpath:` 前缀以及该类的包路径。

items.source: A path starting with a slash will be treated as an absolute path within the classpath, for example: "/org/example/schema.sql". Such a path will be prepended with the classpath: prefix.
items.translation: 以斜杠开头的路径将被视为类路径中的绝对路径，例如："/org/example/schema.sql"。此类路径将添加 classpath: 前缀。

items.source: preservePlaceholders - true if placeholders should be preserved
items.translation: preservePlaceholders - 如果应保留占位符，则为 true

items.source: environment - the Environment to use to resolve property placeholders in the paths
items.translation: environment - 用于解析路径中属性占位符的 Environment

items.source: a new array of resources
items.translation: 一个新的资源数组
